title: Attendance App for Employee
description:
Track staff attendance, run payroll and share salary slips — all from one mobile app. factoTime replaces biometric machines, paper registers and end-of-month spreadsheets with a smarter mobile workflow built for growing businesses.

Whether you run a shop, factory, site, office or field team, every punch is verified with a selfie, GPS and exact timestamp. No hardware, no paper, no buddy punching.

🎯 SMART STAFF ATTENDANCE APP FOR EVERY BUSINESS
factoTime turns every team member's phone into a verified punch device. Mark daily attendance, log working hours and run salary from a single app — anywhere, anytime, on any Android device.

✨ WHY OWNERS, HR AND CONTRACTORS PICK FACTOTIME
• Selfie punch with live GPS location and exact in-out timing
• Three-way proof stops proxy entries and inflated hours
• Multi-shift rules with automatic overtime and late-hour handling
• Holiday calendar, leave management and shift roster, all together
• Works for office, field, remote and contract teams

📸 SELFIE + FACE + GPS — THE 3-WAY PROOF
factoTime works as a selfie attendance app and a face attendance app in one. Every record captures a live selfie, the exact moment and the precise GPS location of the team member. You see who came, when they came and where they were — no phone calls, no chat-group photos, no paper registers.

⏱️ TIME TRACKING AND TIMESHEETS
• Daily, weekly and monthly working-hour summary per employee
• Manual entries by admins when a record is missed
• Full record history for every team member and every workday
• Day, night, split and rotating shift rules with automatic math
• Custom date-range reports for accounting and audits
• A clean timesheet app and time tracking app — export as PDF or Excel

🗓️ FLEXIBLE OPTIONS FOR EVERY TEAM
• Present, Absent, Half Day and Overtime
• Holiday, Week Off and approved Leave categories
• Geo-fencing to restrict punching to your real work location
• QR staff attendance for fixed sites and entry gates
• Mobile attendance app access for owners and supervisors on the move
• Multi-site and multi-team management from one owner account

🚀 HOW TO USE FACTOTIME
1. Sign up your business and add team members in minutes
2. Set pay type, shift and working days for each person
3. Employees install the app and punch with selfie plus GPS
4. Admins watch live data, fix manual entries and approve leave

🎨 PERFECT FOR EVERY KIND OF TEAM
Built for small businesses, SMEs, startups and growing companies worldwide — retail shops, factories, construction sites, security agencies, sales and field teams, drivers, delivery riders, gyms, salons, clinics, schools, NGOs and contractors. A practical work attendance app and time tracking app in your pocket.

🔒 PRIVACY AND SAFETY
✓ Selfie, location and pay data are linked only to your business account
✓ Records are owned by your organisation and visible only to admins
✓ Members can request account deletion through their admin at any time
✓ No personal data is sold or shared with third parties for marketing
✓ Any record can be reported in-app to our support team for review

This app is intended for legitimate workforce management. It must not be used to track any person without their consent or outside the scope of authorised use. Admins are responsible for informing the team that selfie, location and timing data is captured for workforce records and payroll.

Made in India by Version Systems Pvt. Ltd.

Install factoTime today and turn daily punching, timesheets and payroll into a paperless routine your whole team can trust.

title: Stock Manager
description:
Stock Manager is an inventory management app for small businesses, retailers, warehouses and offices. Organize products, monitor stock levels, record inventory activity, and create business reports from one place.

PRODUCT MANAGEMENT

Create product records with names, barcodes, categories, descriptions, purchase and selling prices, stock quantities, locations, and supplier details. Add product images, documents, custom attributes, batch numbers, manufacturing dates, and expiration dates. Edit, duplicate, or safely delete products.

BARCODE AND SMART PRODUCT ENTRY

Scan barcodes with your device camera or enter them manually. Analyze product images to receive suggestions for the product name, barcode, price, description, batch number and relevant dates. Review the results and choose which fields to apply before saving.

SEARCH AND ORGANIZATION

Find products by name, SKU, category, or barcode. Use grid or list view, filter inventory by category, warehouse, or custom attributes, and sort products by name, date, or price.

STOCK MOVEMENTS

Record stock entries, sales, removals, corrections, and warehouse transfers. Add quantities, prices, customer or supplier details, notes, images, and documents. Search and filter history by product, barcode, movement type, date range, or transaction value.

DASHBOARD AND STATISTICS

View total products, stock units, inventory value, recent movements, low-stock and out-of-stock items, purchases, sales, estimated profit, profit margin, and movement balance. Set a custom low-stock threshold to identify products that need attention.

MULTI-WAREHOUSE MANAGEMENT

Create multiple warehouses, choose a default location, review stock by warehouse, and transfer products between locations. Warehouse profiles can include names, addresses, and descriptions.

STOCK COUNTING

Create stock-count sessions and compare recorded quantities with physical stock. Count manually or by scanning barcodes, add notes, identify differences, and apply approved corrections. Review completed sessions and generate count reports.

CUSTOMERS AND SUPPLIERS

Create customer and supplier profiles with company details, contact persons, phone numbers, email addresses, addresses, tax information, payment terms, and notes. View related products and stock movements from each profile.

REPORTS AND DOCUMENTS

Generate product, inventory, movement, transfer, and stock-summary reports in PDF, CSV, or Excel format. Preview, save, print, or share reports and select a date range. Create and archive stock exit slips.

PDF TEMPLATES AND BRANDING

Create invoices, quotations, delivery notes, and stock exit slips with customizable PDF templates. Add your logo, business name, contact details, address, tax information, website, and footer notes. Preview, duplicate, activate, import, or export templates.

BACKUP AND DATA MANAGEMENT

Create manual or automatic local backups. Save, share, and restore backup files when required. Eligible plans may also include cloud synchronization and restoration for supported inventory data.

ACCOUNT AND PREFERENCES

Manage your account, email verification, password, membership, and account deletion request within the app. Choose light or dark mode, change the app language, and customize stock alerts.

FREE AND OPTIONAL PAID FEATURES

The free version includes essential inventory tools and may display advertisements. Some advanced features require an in-app purchase or subscription. Depending on the selected plan, these may include higher or unlimited product limits, AI-assisted scanning, advanced reports, multiple product images, stock counting, customer and supplier directories, multi-warehouse management, cloud protection, and ad removal.

Plans, prices, billing periods, trial eligibility, and renewal information are displayed on the purchase screen before confirmation. AI-assisted and cloud features may require an internet connection, a verified account, and an active eligible plan.

title: My Stuff : Inventory Organiser
description:
My Stuff: Inventory Organizer – Track and Manage All Your Belongings

Easily track and organize your personal belongings and warranties in one place. — from home items to office supplies, gadgets, electronics, documents, collectibles, tools, clothes and more. Keep track of what you own and where it is stored using custom categories and locations. Add photos, quantity, prices, purchase dates, warranty and expiry dates, or barcodes to keep important item details organized. Add items with photos, categories, warranty dates, prices, and even barcodes. Useful for home organization, household inventory, office assets, or personal belongings tracking. Whether you want to find where you stored something, manage household inventory, remember warranty expiry, organize a collection, track stock, scan a barcode, or check the total value of your belongings, My Stuff keeps everything together in one simple place.

⭐ Key Features

📦 Add & Organize Your Stuff

• Add any item: gadgets, tools, clothes, appliances, groceries, documents, toys, furniture • Add photos, purchase date, expiry, warranty, notes, and quantity • Create custom categories and locations • Track items that are in use, out of stock, or expired • You can link an existing barcode while adding items, or create a new one on the spot if you want to track that item using a barcode.

📊 Dashboard Overview

• Quick summary of items, price, categories, and locations • Search items by name, category, or location • Helpful for large households or office asset management

💰 Total Value & Item Count

• See total number of items on dashboard • Auto-calculate total price of your inventory • Know the worth of belongings at home or work

🏷️ Barcode Scanner & Generator

• Scan barcode to find saved items instantly • Add new items by scanning their barcode • Generate custom barcodes inside the app • Save barcodes and search items using them

⏰ Warranty & Expiry Reminders

• Keep expiry alerts on from settings for warranty expiry reminder • Get alerts before items expire or need service • Useful for electronics, appliances, groceries & subscriptions

⚙️ Easy-to-Use Settings

• Light & dark modes • Select your currency • Turn expiry alerts on/off • Show or hide item prices

💾 Backup, Restore, Import & Export

• Export items and photos as a ZIP backup • Import a ZIP backup to restore your inventory • Move your inventory backup to another device • Import items from a CSV or Zip file

⭐ How This App Helps You in Daily Life

🏠 Home Inventory Track appliances, groceries, Toiletries, Self-Care Items, tools, clothes, kitchen items and more. 🧾 Electronics & Warranty Tracking Save warranty dates for mobiles, laptops, TVs, ACs, headphones, gaming gear, and repair bills. 🗂️ Office & Work Supplies Organize stationery, devices, equipment, and office assets. Know where each item is placed. 🎮 Personal Collections Useful for books, games, collectibles, gadgets, accessories, and hobby items. 🛒 Grocery & Stock Tracking Know what is available, what expired, and what needs restocking. 🔍 Instant Search Can't remember where you kept something? Search by name, category, location, or barcode — find it quickly. ⭐ Why People Use This App ✔ Easy inventory management ✔ Saves time searching for items ✔ Helps track warranty expiry ✔ Shows total value of belongings ✔ Barcode scan for fast item lookup ✔ Clean interface and simple controls

Take control of your belongings and manage your inventory easily with the app.

title: Stock & Inventory Manager
description:
# Stock & Inventory Manager – Simple Inventory Management for Small Businesses

Take control of your products, stock levels, and daily inventory operations with Stock and Inventory Manager.

Whether you run a retail shop, a small business, or manage multiple stores, this inventory management app helps you track stock, organize products, record incoming and outgoing goods, and keep your business inventory organized.

Manage your inventory directly from your phone with simple tools designed for everyday business operations.

## KEY FEATURES

### Inventory Management
Keep track of your stock quantities and product information in one place. Add, edit, and organize products with names, images, prices, descriptions, and categories.

### Stock In & Stock Out
Record incoming and outgoing inventory to keep your stock quantities up to date. Monitor product movements and manage your daily stock operations.

### Barcode Scanner
Scan product barcodes to find, add, or update inventory items faster. Reduce manual data entry and make stock management more convenient.

### Low Stock Alerts
Set minimum stock quantities and identify products that need replenishment. Stay informed and avoid unexpected stock shortages.

### Multi-Store & Warehouse Management
Manage inventory across multiple stores or warehouse locations. Keep each location organized and monitor stock separately.

### Inventory Reports
View inventory information and business reports to understand stock levels, product movements, and inventory performance.

### Purchase & Sales Documents
Organize incoming and outgoing inventory documents. Keep track of supplier and customer transactions and their related payment status.

### Cloud Sync
Keep your inventory data synchronized across supported devices. Access updated information wherever you manage your business.

## WHO IS THIS APP FOR?

- Small business owners
- Retail shop owners
- Store managers
- Warehouse operators
- Product sellers

descriptionHTML:
# Stock & Inventory Manager – Simple Inventory Management for Small Businesses

Take control of your products, stock levels, and daily inventory operations with Stock and Inventory Manager.

Whether you run a retail shop, a small business, or manage multiple stores, this inventory management app helps you track stock, organize products, record incoming and outgoing goods, and keep your business inventory organized.

Manage your inventory directly from your phone with simple tools designed for everyday business operations.

## KEY FEATURES

### Inventory Management
Keep track of your stock quantities and product information in one place. Add, edit, and organize products with names, images, prices, descriptions, and categories.

### Stock In & Stock Out
Record incoming and outgoing inventory to keep your stock quantities up to date. Monitor product movements and manage your daily stock operations.

### Barcode Scanner
Scan product barcodes to find, add, or update inventory items faster. Reduce manual data entry and make stock management more convenient.

### Low Stock Alerts
Set minimum stock quantities and identify products that need replenishment. Stay informed and avoid unexpected stock shortages.

### Multi-Store & Warehouse Management
Manage inventory across multiple stores or warehouse locations. Keep each location organized and monitor stock separately.

### Inventory Reports
View inventory information and business reports to understand stock levels, product movements, and inventory performance.

### Purchase & Sales Documents
Organize incoming and outgoing inventory documents. Keep track of supplier and customer transactions and their related payment status.

### Cloud Sync
Keep your inventory data synchronized across supported devices. Access updated information wherever you manage your business.

## WHO IS THIS APP FOR?

- Small business owners
- Retail shop owners
- Store managers
- Warehouse operators
- Product sellers
- Businesses managing multiple locations

Spend less time organizing stock and more time running your business.

Download Stock and Inventory Manager and make everyday stock tracking easier.

Transform your team's productivity and collaboration with MeisterTask - The Ultimate Task Management Tool. Whether you’re looking to track tasks and todos or lead full-scale projects to success, MeisterTask offers a simple yet powerful project management and task management tool that takes you seamlessly from web to mobile and back again. 

Why Choose MeisterTask?

🚀 Seamless Integration Across Platforms. Experience the perfect blend of simplicity and power with MeisterTask. Designed to synchronize flawlessly with our comprehensive web application, our mobile app brings robust project management right to your fingertips.

🌟 Empower Collaboration with Kanban-Style Boards. Effortless organization and dynamic teamwork in your pocket. MeisterTask's intuitive Kanban-style boards are tailored for managing projects of all scales, enabling you and your team to visualize progress and streamline workflows with ease.

🎉 Where Work Meets Fun. Discover the joy in productivity. MeisterTask's engaging interface and user-friendly features make managing tasks not just efficient but enjoyable. It's where work transforms into an experience that teams look forward to every day.

✅ Get Started for Free with MeisterTask Today. Join the community of teams who are achieving more with less stress. Download MeisterTask now and elevate your project management experience to new heights!

🔥 Reach Your Team's Potential. Unlock the full power of task management with our Pro and Business plans. Experience advanced features designed for dialed efficiency and scalability – tailor-made for those who seek excellence in team collaboration and project execution.


Note: MeisterTask requires a free account registration. If you already have an account, using the mobile app causes no additional costs. Not all features of MeisterTask are available on Mobile.

The Basic version of MeisterTask is free. You can try the Pro Plan free once for two weeks after signing up. If you enjoy your Pro trial, do nothing, and your membership will automatically continue as an auto-renewing month-to-month subscription. You can cancel anytime via the app store. 

If you subscribe via Google Play: Payment will be charged to your Google Play Account at confirmation of purchase. If you haven’t subscribed through Google Play, you can manage your subscription through MeisterTask.
